description: This file defines the MessageFormatter class within the GuzzleHttp namespace, which implements message logging functionality with variable substitutions for HTTP requests, responses, and related data, used primarily for debugging or logging in Guzzle HTTP client.

classes.name: MessageFormatter
classes.description: A class responsible for formatting log messages for HTTP requests and responses, supporting variable substitutions for dynamic content related to the request, response, and other context data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the message formatter with a specified template, defaulting to the Common Log Format (CLF).

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates a formatted log message string based on the provided request, response, and error objects by replacing placeholders in the template.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Helper method that extracts headers from a PSR MessageInterface object and formats them as a string.
